title: ygjson eras
description: sets/eras.json: the TCG eras, named for the anime series and summoning mechanic players know them by. No source carries them; a set's era is the one whose window holds its release date.

mechanic.description: The summoning mechanic the era introduced.

from.description: First day of the era, inclusive.

to.description: Last day of the era, inclusive. Absent for the current era.
